name: Accounts and onboarding
ac: Verify email, sign in and retain own profile; record initial skill assessment.

name: Tutorial and controls
ac: Complete or replay rule/control steps; retain completion for the account.

name: Guided technique drills
ac: Validate the target technique; score 1–3 stars; first completion earns one reward.

name: XP levels and unlocks
ac: Apply eligible XP/unlocks once; wallet and progress persist after refresh.

name: Adaptive bot and coaching
ac: Scale bot difficulty, identify technique errors and recommend weak drills; evaluate placement/classifiers.

name: Shots movement and rules
ac: Enforce legal serve, two-bounce, kitchen, net, scoring and supported shot combinations.

name: Elo queue and ready check
ac: Both clients can accept; start only after required acceptances; decline cancels safely.

name: Private rooms and invitations
ac: Create/join 1v1 or 2v2; validate invite, capacity, team and ready roster.

name: Online singles and doubles
ac: Synchronize legal inputs and score; apply disconnect policy with trusted simulation.

name: Results rating and awards
ac: Finalize one agreed result; update Elo, reward and history once; reject conflicting replay.

name: Progress history and replay
ac: Show accuracy/time/mastery trends, match history and participant-authorized replay.

name: Friends and leaderboard
ac: Authorize requests/invitations; list friends and consistently order Elo ranks.

name: Daily streak and achievements
ac: Claim each eligible objective or streak reward once per period; preserve balances.

name: Offline practice and sync
ac: Complete drills without a connection; reconcile progress once after reconnect.

name: Admin access and users
ac: Authorize admin login; search, sanction, restore, reset progress and assign roles.

name: Playable content CMS
ac: Create, edit, publish/unpublish valid lesson/drill/difficulty data visible in game.

name: Monitoring and moderation
ac: Inspect active/completed matches; resolve reports, disconnect cases and appeals.

name: Operational analytics
ac: Report dated active users, retention, lesson use, error heatmaps and queue health.
